title: Titanium Stem Faceplate Bolt
function: M5x16mm Torx T25 tapered head stem clamping bolt
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is specified for Titanium Stem Faceplate Bolt because its 900+ MPa tensile strength allows thin-wall tube shaping without buckling, critical for lightweight frame and component structures. The alpha-beta microstructure delivers 45% higher specific strength than 4140 chromoly steel, translating directly to gram-level weight savings where it matters. Its high-cycle fatigue endurance limit (>500 MPa @10^7 cycles) matches the pedaling load spectrum of M5x16mm Torx T25 tapered head stem clamping bolt. This rationale is driven by m5x16mm torx t25 tapered head stem clamping bolt and fat life requirements.
process: CNC turning Swiss-type for stem hardware geometry
Thread rolling DIN 13-1 6g with 0.5mm corner radius
Go/No-Go ring gauging with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for m5x16mm torx t25 application
commonFailures: Fatigue failure at head tube junction - mitigated by smooth weld radius >=5mm + post-weld shot peening — critical for m5x16mm torx t25 performance

faq.q: What surface finishes are compatible with Titanium Stem Faceplate Bolt for cycling use?
faq.a: Titanium Stem Faceplate Bolt can be supplied with bead-blasted matte (Ra 1.6-3.2 µm), brushed satin, mirror polish, or PVD-colored finish. Bead-blasted + passivation is the standard for m5x16mm torx t25 as it provides the best balance of cosmetic consistency, corrosion resistance, and cost. Anodized colors (gold, blue, purple per ASTM B136) are available on request.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Stem Faceplate Bolt orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Stem Faceplate Bolt is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Stem Faceplate Bolt?
faq.a: Each Titanium Stem Faceplate Bolt shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for m5x16mm torx t25.

sceneDescription: Titanium Stem Faceplate Bolt is a lightweight m5x16mm torx t25 component engineered for M5x16mm Torx T25 tapered head stem clamping bolt. Forged and CNC machined from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V, it achieves 40-45% weight savings versus steel while maintaining the fatigue life required for demanding cycling applications. Threaded interfaces are designed to prevent galling in outdoor environments.
